logp.method_description: The standard octanol–water partition coefficient (logP7.4) of 4–6 was determined using the shake-flask method. In an Eppendorf, together, 10 μL (10 mg mL–1) of each complex, 750 μL of n-octanol, and 750 μL of PBS solution (pH = 7.4, [PO43–] = 100 mM) were mixed. The mixtures were shaken on a vortexer for 25 min and then centrifuged at 3000 rpm for 5 min to separate the two phases. The absorbance of each phase was registered. For each phase, the absorbance was recorded and then the partition coefficient was computed as an average of three triplicates (log{[complex]o/[complex]}w).
